name: semantic
optimizer: new Adam, same for all arms
augmentation: Aligned H/V flips and 0/90/180/270 degree rotations in every arm
training_targets: Original maps/images only, newly sampled holes, class-uniform anchoring.
semantic_guard: Original-image teacher prediction must match the real label with confidence >=0.5; classes2..7 only. No edited maps/images used for training.
teacher_metric_warning: For this guided arm, teacher recognition is an optimization diagnostic. Use a separately trained audit evaluator for comparison.
